<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def pg1(f):
    L=f.ascii.split('\n')
    return ''.join(''.join('1' if L[r][c]=='B' else '0' for c in range(22,27)) for r in range(52,57))
seq=[]
g0=pg1(current_frame)
seq.append(g0)
print("start:", g0)
for i in range(12):
    res=action(['UP'])
    r=last_action_result
    seq.append(pg1(current_frame))
    if r.get('no_impact') or r.get('done') or r.get('level_completed') or r.get('game_over'):
        print("stopped at", i, r.get('no_impact'), r.get('done'))
        break
print("cycle len guess:")
for i,g in enumerate(seq): print(i, g)
# find first repeat
for i in range(1,len(seq)):
    if seq[i]==seq[0]:
        print("cycle length:", i); break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
